0022600146.text: The Memphis Grizzlies, 3-0 and on a three-game winning streak, visit the Portland Trail Blazers, who are 2-0, in Memphis's fifth game of the season. Memphis is 2-0 on the road and sits 2nd in the Southwest, while Portland is 1-0 at home, 2nd in the Northwest and 0.5 games back. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Memphis lost 1-3 to Portland in 2025-26, including a 122-114 defeat in Memphis on March 4, 2026. Portland will be without Chris Youngblood (out, ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery).
